The observed scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, suggesting that Bremelanotide could interact with Dl-Anabasine to affect A2780cisR through the FcRn receptor. The mechanism is supported by the presence of a direct target relationship between Bremelanotide and FcRn p51, and a subsequent target relationship between Dl-Anabasine and A2780cisR. This integrated pathway highlights the potential for Bremelanotide to influence A2780cisR through a receptor-mediated mechanism, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact nature of the interaction.
